WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id,
           CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT)
                   WHEN 1 THEN CAST('9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT)
                   WHEN 2 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS dividend,
           CASE id WHEN 0 THEN CAST('9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT)
                   WHEN 1 THEN CAST(1 AS BIGINT)
                   WHEN 3 THEN CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) ELSE CAST(3 AS BIGINT) END AS divisor
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, PMOD(dividend,divisor) AS result FROM operands
SELECT id, PMOD(i,CASE WHEN id=1 THEN 0 ELSE p END) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id, PMOD(i,CASE WHEN id=0 THEN 0 ELSE p END) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id, PMOD(i,CASE WHEN id=1 THEN -3 ELSE p END) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8

WITH operands AS (
    SELECT id, CASE WHEN id=1 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775807' AS BIGINT) ELSE i END AS dividend,
               CASE WHEN id=1 THEN CAST('-9223372036854775808' AS BIGINT) ELSE CAST(p AS BIGINT) END AS divisor
    FROM bench WHERE id < 8
)
SELECT id, PMOD(dividend,divisor) AS result FROM operands
SELECT id,PMOD(i,7L) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id,PMOD(CAST(i AS INT),p) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 8

SELECT id,
    PMOD(CAST(i AS DOUBLE), CAST(p AS DOUBLE)) AS floating_result,
    PMOD(CAST(i AS DECIMAL(18,2)), CAST(p AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS decimal_result
FROM bench WHERE id < 8
SELECT id,PMOD(i,p) AS result FROM bench WHERE id < 0
